/* selectOrgDetail - Lee JiSeob */
SELECT
INST_NO, INST_NM, UP_INST_NO, UP_INST_NM, UP_APRV_INST_NO, UP_APRV_INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_TYPE_NM,
CASE UNIT_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN '' WHEN 1 THEN UNIT_NM ELSE '(' || UNIT_COUNT || ') ' || UNIT_NM END AS UNIT_NM,
UNIT_COUNT, UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, RGN_CD, HPGE_URL_ADDR, MAIN_ENFC_INST_SE_CD, BPLC_ZIP, BPLC_PST_ADDR, BPLC_DADDR, C##RG.DEC_B64(RPRSV_NM_ENCPT) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, RPRS_TELNO, RPRS_FXNO, APLCN_BGNG_YMD, APLCN_END_YMD, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_NM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT, PIC_TELNO, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT, PIC_ENFSN_NO, CNSGN_YMD, APLY_YMD, APLCNT_ID, APRV_YN, RJCT_CS_CN, PRCS_YMD, AUTZR_ID, ATFINO, (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = AUTZR_ENFSN_NO) AS AUTZR_ENCPT, DEL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT,
CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, OFFCS_SGNNG_NO,
CTPV_CD, SGG_CD,
C##RG.DEC_B64(AUTZR_NM) AS AUTZR_NM, CNTER_PRECON_WRT_YN,
RSFR_INST_YN, (CASE APRV_STTS_SE_CD WHEN '1' THEN '1' WHEN '3' THEN '3' ELSE '2' END) AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD FROM ( SELECT
C.INST_NO, C.INST_NM, C.UP_INST_NO, (SELECT G.INST_NM FROM SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = C.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NM, C.UP_APRV_INST_NO, (SELECT G.INST_NM FROM SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = C.UP_APRV_INST_NO) AS UP_APRV_INST_NM, C.INST_TYPE_SE_CD, (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'INST_TYPE_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = TO_CHAR(C.INST_TYPE_SE_CD)) AS INST_TYPE_NM, /* (SELECT F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 F WHERE F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_SYS_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNIT_NM, */ (SELECT G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 G /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNIT_NM, CASE WHEN C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS UNIT_COUNT, C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, C.RGN_CD, C.HPGE_URL_ADDR, C.MAIN_ENFC_INST_SE_CD, C.BPLC_ZIP, C.BPLC_PST_ADDR, C.BPLC_DADDR, C.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, C.RPRS_TELNO, C.RPRS_FXNO, C.APLCN_BGNG_YMD, C.APLCN_END_YMD, C.PIC_NM_ENCPT, C.PIC_TELNO, C.PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C.PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT, C.PIC_ENFSN_NO, C.CNSGN_YMD, C.APLY_YMD, C.APLCNT_ID, C.APRV_YN, D.RJCT_CS_CN, C.PRCS_YMD, D.AUTZR_ID, (SELECT ENFSN_NO FROM SAA200 WHERE USER_ID = D.AUTZR_ID) AS AUTZR_ENFSN_NO, C.ATFINO, C.DEL_YN, C.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(C.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FRST_REG_DT, C.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(C.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT,
C.CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, C.SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, C.EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, C.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO,
C.CTPV_CD, C.SGG_CD,
C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(C.AUTZR_ID) AS AUTZR_NM, C.CNTER_PRECON_WRT_YN,
C.RSFR_INST_YN, D.APRV_STTS_SE_CD FROM SAA000 C /* 통합기관 */ LEFT JOIN (SELECT B.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.INST_NO ORDER BY B.APLY_DT DESC) AS RN FROM SAA010 B
) AS D ON C.INST_NO = D.INST_NO AND D.RN = '1' WHERE C.INST_NO = #{orgCode} ) X

/* selectOrgDetailHistoryData - Taesoo Song */
SELECT
INST_NO, INST_NM, UP_INST_NO, UP_INST_NM, UP_APRV_INST_NO, UP_APRV_INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_TYPE_NM,

FROM ( SELECT

CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, OFFCS_SGNNG_NO,
CTPV_CD, SGG_CD,
C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(AUTZR_ID) AS AUTZR_NM, CNTER_PRECON_WRT_YN,
RSFR_INST_YN
FROM SAA001 C /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = #{orgCode} AND MDFCN_DT = TO_DATE(#{MDFCN_DT}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') ) X

/* selectOrgName - Lee Ji Seob */
SELECT INST_NO, INST_NM
FROM SAA000 /* 통합기관 */
WHERE INST_NM LIKE '%' || #{instNm} || '%' AND (DEL_YN IS NULL OR DEL_YN = 'N')
ORDER BY INST_NM, INST_NO

/* selectRepresentativePhone - Lee JiSeob - 사용자 소속 기관의 대표 전화번호 구하기 */
SELECT D.RPRS_TELNO /* 대표전화번호 */
FROM SAB230 C /* 사용자별 기관 권한 */ JOIN SAA000 D /* 통합기관 */ ON D.INST_NO = C.INST_NO
WHERE C.USER_ID = #{USER_ID} AND C.MAIST_YN = 'Y'

/* selectOrgDetailHistory - Taesoo Song */
SELECT
MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, INST_NO, INST_NM, UP_INST_NO, UP_INST_NM, UP_APRV_INST_NO, UP_APRV_INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, INST_TYPE_NM,
CASE UNIT_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN '' WHEN 1 THEN UNIT_NM ELSE '(' || UNIT_COUNT || ') ' || UNIT_NM END AS UNIT_NM,
UNIT_COUNT, UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, RGN_CD, HPGE_URL_ADDR, MAIN_ENFC_INST_SE_CD, BPLC_ZIP, BPLC_PST_ADDR, BPLC_DADDR, C##RG.DEC_B64(RPRSV_NM_ENCPT) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, RPRS_TELNO, RPRS_FXNO, APLCN_BGNG_YMD, APLCN_END_YMD, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_NM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT, PIC_TELNO, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, C##RG.DEC_B64(PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT, PIC_ENFSN_NO, CNSGN_YMD, APLY_YMD, APLCNT_ID, APRV_YN, RJCT_CS_CN, PRCS_YMD, AUTZR_ID, ATFINO, DEL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT,
CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, OFFCS_SGNNG_NO,
CTPV_CD, CTPV_CD_NM, SGG_CD, SGG_CD_NM,
C##RG.DEC_B64(AUTZR_NM) AS AUTZR_NM, CNTER_PRECON_WRT_YN, C##RG.DEC_B64(MDFCN_NM) AS MDFCN_NM, RSFR_INST_YN
FROM ( SELECT
MDFCN_DT, DATAA_CHG_SE_CD, INST_NO, INST_NM, UP_INST_NO, (SELECT G.INST_NM FROM SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = C.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NM, UP_APRV_INST_NO, (SELECT G.INST_NM FROM SAA000 G /* 통합기관 */ WHERE G.INST_NO = C.UP_APRV_INST_NO) AS UP_APRV_INST_NM, INST_TYPE_SE_CD, (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'INST_TYPE_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = TO_CHAR(C.INST_TYPE_SE_CD)) AS INST_TYPE_NM, /* (SELECT F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 F WHERE F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_SYS_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNIT_NM, */ (SELECT G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 G /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNIT_NM, CASE WHEN C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS UNIT_COUNT, C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, RGN_CD, HPGE_URL_ADDR, MAIN_ENFC_INST_SE_CD, BPLC_ZIP, BPLC_PST_ADDR, BPLC_DADDR, RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, RPRS_TELNO, RPRS_FXNO, APLCN_BGNG_YMD, APLCN_END_YMD, PIC_NM_ENCPT, PIC_TELNO, PIC_MBL_TELNO_ENCPT, PIC_EML_ADDR_ENCPT, PIC_ENFSN_NO, CNSGN_YMD, APLY_YMD, APLCNT_ID, APRV_YN, RJCT_CS_CN, PRCS_YMD, AUTZR_ID, ATFINO, DEL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT,
CTPV_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, SGG_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, EMD_LINK_PBADMS_RGN_CD, OFFCS_SGNNG_NO,
CTPV_CD, (SELECT G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 G /* 공통코드 값 */ WHERE G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CTPV_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = TO_CHAR(C.CTPV_CD)) AS CTPV_CD_NM, SGG_CD, (SELECT ZX.SGG_NM FROM SAA020 ZX WHERE ZX.SGG_CD = C.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD_NM,
C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(AUTZR_ID) AS AUTZR_NM, CNTER_PRECON_WRT_YN, C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(C.LAST_MDFR_ID ) AS MDFCN_NM, RSFR_INST_YN
FROM SAA001 C /* 통합기관 */ WHERE INST_NO = #{orgCode} ORDER BY FRST_REG_DT DESC ) X

/* selectOrgRenameDetail - Taesoo Song */ SELECT NVL(A.INST_NM, B.INST_NM) AS INST_NM2 , NVL(A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD, B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD) AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD2 , NVL(A.UP_INST_NO, B.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NO2 , NVL((SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = A.UP_INST_NO), (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = B.UP_INST_NO)) AS UP_INST_NM2 , NVL(A.UP_APRV_INST_NO, B.UP_APRV_INST_NO) AS UP_APRV_INST_NO2 , NVL((SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = A.UP_APRV_INST_NO), (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = B.UP_APRV_INST_NO)) AS UP_APRV_INST_NM2 , NVL(A.CTPV_CD, B.CTPV_CD) AS CTPV_CD2 , NVL(A.SGG_CD, B.SGG_CD) AS SGG_CD2 , C##RG.DEC_B64(NVL(A.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT, B.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT)) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT2 , NVL(A.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO, B.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO) AS OFFCS_SGNNG_NO2 , NVL((SELECT D.ATFINO FROM SAA230 D WHERE D.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO = A.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO AND USE_YN = 'Y'), (SELECT D.ATFINO FROM SAA230 D WHERE D.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO = B.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO AND USE_YN = 'Y')) AS ATFINO2 , NVL((SELECT D.MNG_SN FROM SAA230 D WHERE D.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO = A.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO AND USE_YN = 'Y'), (SELECT D.MNG_SN FROM SAA230 D WHERE D.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO = B.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO AND USE_YN = 'Y')) AS MNG_SN2 , B.INST_NM AS INST_NM , B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , B.UP_INST_NO AS UP_INST_NO , (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = B.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NM , B.UP_APRV_INST_NO AS UP_APRV_INST_NO , (SELECT D.INST_NM FROM SAA000 D /* 기관코드 */ WHERE D.INST_NO = B.UP_APRV_INST_NO) AS UP_APRV_INST_NM , B.CTPV_CD AS CTPV_CD , B.SGG_CD AS SGG_CD , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.RPRSV_NM_ENCPT) AS RPRSV_NM_ENCPT , B.ATFINO AS ATFINO , (SELECT F.MNG_SN FROM SAA230 F WHERE F.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO = B.OFFCS_SGNNG_NO AND F.ATFINO = B.ATFINO) AS MNG_SN , A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , A.RJCT_CS_CN AS RJCT_CS_CN FROM SAA010 A JOIN SAA000 B ON A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = #{APRV_STTS_SE_CD} WHERE A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO}
AND TO_CHAR(A.APLY_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') = #{APLY_DT}

SELECT INST_NO , INST_NM , INST_TYPE_SE_CD , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , CTPV_CD , RGN_CD , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = A.UP_INST_NO) AS UP_INST_NM FROM SAA000 A WHERE 1=1 AND A.INST_NO IN
#{item}
